name: LADWA 750mm Unbreakable Rubber Reflective Traffic Safety Cone
shortDescription: Heavy-duty unbreakable rubberized road cone with 3.2kg weighted base and dual high-intensity reflective sleeves for all-weather highway safety.
overview: The LADWA 750mm unbreakable road safety cone is precision-crafted for extreme duty on expressways, construction bypasses, and industrial logistics parks. Molded from an advanced composite of high-grade vulcanized natural rubber and impact-modified polymers, this cone withstands direct wheel impacts from fully loaded cement mixers and dump trucks without cracking, tearing, or permanent distortion. Equipped with dual class-leading reflective collars, it casts blinding retro-reflective light back to approaching drivers at distances over 350 meters.
keyFeatures: Unbreakable polymer-rubber blend withstands repeated direct vehicle roll-overs
Heavy 3.2 kg weighted square base maintains stability in turbulent gale winds
Dual reflective sleeves (upper 150mm and lower 100mm) ensure 360° visibility
All-weather operational stability: will not melt in 60°C heat or shatter in sub-zero frost
Interlocking stacking ribs prevent cones from sticking together when nested
Molded top grip loop accepts safety barrier chain connectors and hazard lamps
Tested and approved for NHAI highway projects and metropolitan police roadblocks

specifications.Reflective Sheeting: Dual Class RA2 Prismatic Reflective Sleeves

Toll plaza queue management and emergency lane closures
Heavy industrial refinery and steel plant internal transport roads
Municipal civil excavations and sewer replacement projects
